LanguageData.VGE_TheGravship.scenario.name: The Hellion
LanguageData.VGE_TheGravship.scenario.description: Your Hellion engine is burning out. You managed to drift into an empty patch of orbit to bleed off the heat, but the cooldown cycle is excruciatingly slow. You know your pursuers are right behind you. It is only a matter of hours before their Hellion drops into your local space and the boarding action begins. You must fortify your aircraft, patch up your crew, and prepare to repel boarders. If you survive, the space is yours.\n\nNote: This is a difficult scenario and is not recommended for new players.
